requirement.title: Professional graphics/video settings preserve visible quality across scalable low-spec budgets
requirement.origin: Owner-directed P1C01 visual-economy and professional Graphics/Video Settings requirement
requirement.intent: Provide a production-grade Graphics/Video settings system with a strong CinematicBalanced default, scalable Performance/High/Ultra presets and Custom controls while preserving the 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor on the target i7 Gen6/8 GB/~2 GB VRAM laptop class.
evidence: Docs/WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER.md — P1C01 Graphics/Video Visual-Economy Doctrine V4
implementation_refs: CinematicBalanced is the visually strong default direction; Performance, High, Ultra and Custom remain explicit alternatives.
Existing lower-tier scalability anchors are protected until measured evidence authorizes change.

Visual-economy protects silhouette/composition/hero materials/lighting/atmosphere/near-field detail and recovers cost first from duplicate actors/far shadows/overdraw/translucency/redundant lights/uninstanced repetition/unnecessary Tick/invisible or far detail.
Display-mode changes require preview, explicit confirm and timed/manual revert semantics.
Heavy visual assets remain soft-referenced/asynchronously loaded; repeated decorative detail remains ISM/HISM + LOD/culling and crowds remain pooled.
missing_work: Land this requirement and DEC-087 in Data/ProjectGovernor.json.
Implement the bounded UE4.27 GameUserSettings/runtime settings architecture inside P1C01 only.
Add exact-head static validation and UE4.27 compile proof.
PIE-test preset application, Custom transitions and display preview/confirm/revert.
Measure representative P1C01 frame time, VRAM/streaming pool and hitch behavior on the target laptop class.
Obtain human visual acceptance before calling the default or higher presets visually accepted.
acceptance_criteria: CinematicBalanced is a coherent visually strong default rather than an unbounded maximum-quality preset.
Performance preserves the existing 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor contract and does not silently raise lower-tier scalability anchors.
High and Ultra scale upward without changing story/gameplay behavior or bypassing streaming/residency rules.
Custom exposes supported quality controls without creating invalid combinations or weakening fail-safe display reversion.
No performance or visual-quality improvement is claimed without exact measured evidence.
requirement.notes: Governance payload only; runtime source stays closed until ProjectGovernor authority lands.

decision.title: P1C01 Graphics/Video settings use visual-economy presets with CinematicBalanced default
decision.resolution: Authorize P1C01-only implementation of a professional Graphics/Video settings system whose default is CinematicBalanced, whose lower-cost Performance preset protects the existing 720p Low-Medium 30 FPS floor, and whose High/Ultra/Custom modes scale quality without discarding the permanent visual-economy doctrine.
implementation_contract: Runtime scope is W01_P1C01_PRODUCTION_VERTICAL_SLICE only until predecessor Gates 6/7 authorize later runtime chapters.
Preset surface is Performance, CinematicBalanced, High, Ultra and Custom; CinematicBalanced is the default direction.

Existing lower-tier anchors remain protected: texture pools 600/800/1000 MB; shadow max resolution 512/768/1024; cascades 1/2/2; shadow distance 0.45/0.65/0.80; foliage and grass density 0.30/0.50/0.70; view distance 0.45/0.65/0.80.
The target floor remains UE4.27.2 DX11 at 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS on i7 Gen6/8 GB/~2 GB VRAM class hardware.
Protect silhouette, composition, hero materials, lighting, atmosphere and near-field detail before reducing visible hero value.
Recover cost first from duplicate actors, far shadows, overdraw, translucency, redundant lights, uninstanced repetition, unnecessary Tick and invisible/far detail.
Display changes use preview -> confirm -> revert; failure or timeout returns to the last confirmed safe mode.
Heavy assets remain soft references with FStreamableManager async loading; crowds remain pooled; repeated decorative detail remains ISM/HISM + LOD/culling.
Animated final assets remain FBX and production textures remain PNG/TGA, including channel-packed textures.
No COMPILE-TESTED, PIE-TESTED, DEVICE-TESTED, VISUALLY-ACCEPTED or performance-improvement claim is permitted without exact evidence.
decision.rationale: The P1C01 benchmark needs a strong visual default and scalable quality path without sacrificing the strict target-laptop floor. Bounded presets plus permanent cost-recovery priorities make visual ambition scalable instead of flattening the whole scene.
evidence: Docs/WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER.md — P1C01 Graphics/Video Visual-Economy Doctrine V4
decision.evidence_boundary: GOVERNANCE AUTHORITY PAYLOAD ONLY. Runtime settings implementation, UE compile, PIE, target-device, visual acceptance and performance measurement remain separate gates.
